name: omarchy-live-theme
description: Paints the Claude desktop app in the active Omarchy theme and follows theme switches live, with an animated backdrop matched to each theme's wallpapers

scene.title: Animated backdrop
scene.description: Draw an animated scene behind the conversation in the theme's colors. Off leaves only the colors

scene_style.title: Backdrop style
scene_style.description: auto picks the scene that matches the theme's own wallpapers; or force one for every theme

poll_seconds.title: Check every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to look for an Omarchy theme switch
